When the system can display the response, the dialog omits the trail conditions. */ let dialog = IntentDialog(full: "The latest conditions reported for \(trail.name) indicate: \(trail.currentConditions).", supporting: "Here's the latest information on trail conditions.") return .result(value: trail, dialog: dialog, view: snippet) } ```
